name: Devices
author: sceny
description: Your phones and tablets in the Omarchy bar through KDE Connect: battery, shortcuts, a media carousel with seek and volume, notifications with reply and dismiss, and a full text-message view.

barWidget.description: Your phone or tablet in the bar through KDE Connect: battery at a glance; click for shortcuts, media, notifications and messages.

schema.label: Show shortcuts
schema.description: The row of quick action buttons under the header.

schema.label: Show now playing
schema.description: What the phone is playing, while something plays.

schema.label: Show notifications
schema.description: The phone's notifications, with reply and dismiss.

schema.label: Shortcuts
schema.description: Which shortcut buttons show, in order. Edited from the panel's settings page (gear icon).

schema.label: Show battery percentage
schema.description: Off shows the phone glyph alone.

schema.label: Low battery warning (%)
schema.description: At or below this, and not charging, the bar pill turns urgent. 0 turns the warning off.

schema.label: Device ID
schema.description: Empty follows the first paired device that is connected. Set an ID from `kdeconnect-cli -l` to pin one.
